name: Strange World
source: In Strange World you will take on the role of a being who, for unknown reasons, has entered a state of deep sleep. When he wakes up he discovers that the world is not, but the same, you will fight against heroes who had the duty to protect the world and you will conquer women who appeared on your journey.
translation: In Strange World you will take on the role of a being who, for unknown reasons, has entered a state of deep sleep. When he wakes up he discovers that the world is not, but the same, you will fight against heroes who had the duty to protect the world and you will conquer women who appeared on your journey.
